_README: ADD NEW ITEMS HERE. Copy any block below, change the values, done. The site rebuilds its grids automatically. Fields: id (unique, no spaces) | title | blurb (1-2 sentences) | type: guide|skill|knowledge-base|business-plan|tool | price: 'Free' or '$29' etc | url (where it goes) | featured: true shows it on the homepage | date: YYYY-MM-DD | cta (button text, optional) | badge (optional, e.g. 'New')

stripe._README: Your Stripe PUBLISHABLE key. It starts with pk_live_ or pk_test_ and is designed to be public - it is safe in this file. NEVER put a secret key (sk_...) here or anywhere in this repo. Leave blank until you have created products in Stripe.

items.title: SD Card Video Recovery
items.blurb: A free Claude skill that gets back camera clips you deleted or formatted off an SD card. Plug in the card, tell Claude what you lost, and it does the rest.

items.title: Claude Skills Starter Pack
items.blurb: Five production-ready Claude skills you can drop into any project today, plus the file structure and frontmatter that makes them fire reliably.

items.title: The Knowledge Base Blueprint
items.blurb: How to structure a knowledge base an AI can actually navigate — chunking, naming, cross-linking, and the retrieval mistakes that quietly wreck accuracy.

items.title: AI Business Plan Kit
items.blurb: The full template I use to take a business idea from one sentence to a funded plan — market sizing, unit economics, and the AI prompts that pressure-test every assumption.

_EXAMPLE_PAYMENT_LINK._how: Simplest. Stripe Dashboard > Payment Links > create one, copy the URL into 'url'. Nothing else needed - not even the publishable key.
_EXAMPLE_PAYMENT_LINK.title: Product sold with a Stripe Payment Link
_EXAMPLE_PAYMENT_LINK.blurb: Clicking the card sends the buyer straight to Stripe's hosted checkout.

_EXAMPLE_BUY_BUTTON._how: Keeps the buyer on your site. Stripe Dashboard > Product catalogue > your product > Create buy button, then copy the buy-button-id. Requires stripe.publishableKey above to be filled in.
_EXAMPLE_BUY_BUTTON.title: Product sold with an embedded Stripe button
_EXAMPLE_BUY_BUTTON.blurb: Clicking the card opens a checkout page on this site with Stripe's button on it.
